answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond: before an agent can act, it locks real capital. Joining is no longer free, so spinning up a whole river of cloned identities burns money fast. Each agent signs its attestations like a scribe wielding a quill, and honest peers audit the work. A steady record reads like a disciplined sonnet, line by verified line, while sybils watch their bonds drain on rejected claims they can never recover.
